title: Local-global principles for visibility of lattice points on parameterized curves
summary: We develop a local-global theory for visibility of lattice points on families of parameterized curves. We introduce a notion of $p$-adic visibility and ask whether a lattice point is globally visible precisely when it is visible at every prime. We prove that this local-global principle holds for a broad class of families whose parametrizations are homogeneous with respect to positive weights.
